title: Mind Games
description: A mobile application containing three algorithm-based games: Tic-Tac-Toe, 8 Puzzle, and N-Queen. The project focused on implementing different artificial intelligence and algorithmic problem-solving techniques.
extra: Alpha-Beta Pruning, A* Search, Manhattan Distance, Brute Force, and Backtracking.

title: Online Food Ordering System
description: A web-based food ordering system with user authentication, food ordering, order processing, and order history functionality.

title: Online Clothing Recommendation System
description: A content-based clothing recommendation system that recommends products based on their similarity. The system uses cosine similarity to compare product characteristics.
extra: Content-based filtering using cosine similarity with a Kaggle dataset.
